Integrate Token Lifecycle with GPTReader, Azure Functions, and Auth APIs

Integrate lifecycle validation into GPTReader and Azure Functions entry points and expose internal APIs for token issuance, rotation, and revocation. Ensure all inbound requests require valid bearer tokens and lifecycle enforcement is consistently applied.
change_log.note: Add API responsibility without creating duplicate story

stories.title: Define Token Schema and Contract
stories.description: Define the bearer token structure including token_id, subject, scopes, issued_at, expires_at, rotation_version, and revocation status. Establish serialization, signing expectations, and validation rules aligned with existing auth.py behavior.

stories.title: Implement Core Token Lifecycle Logic
stories.description: Implement token issuance, rotation, expiration, and revocation logic. Enforce TTL-based expiration, rotation via versioning, and revocation checks during validation using patterns established in auth.py.

stories.title: Token Validation Middleware and Access Enforcement
stories.description: Implement request-level enforcement for bearer tokens via middleware/interceptors. Validate signature, expiration, scope, and revocation status on all protected endpoints. Enforce consistent 401/403 responses and scope-based access control across services.

stories.title: Token Lifecycle Unit and Integration Tests
stories.description: Create unit and integration tests covering issuance, expiration, rotation, revocation, and validation enforcement. Include edge cases such as expired tokens, invalid signatures, replay attempts, and revoked tokens.

stories.title: Integrate Token Lifecycle with GPTReader, Azure Functions, and Auth APIs
stories.description: Integrate lifecycle validation into GPTReader and Azure Functions entry points and expose internal APIs for token issuance, rotation, and revocation. Ensure all inbound requests require valid bearer tokens and lifecycle enforcement is consistently applied across data access and pipeline operations.
